tracks.title: Test Tubes, Flasks, Beakers, and Pipettes

metadata.author: Laura Baker, Lynn Huggins-Cooper
metadata.description:
"Explore Chemistry, from the building blocks of our world to experiments and energy technology.   

This audiobook is packed with clear and engaging explanations of chemical reactions, the Periodic Table, fireworks, and more.  

Supporting STEM learning, this book covers core chemistry topics in an entertaining and easy-to-understand way.   

Big new concepts come to life through an engaging, energetic text. Kids will love sharing these facts with friends and family!   

Young readers will love exploring exhilarating new ideas about:    • elements   • compounds   • molecules   • atoms   • and much more!   

A great listen for scientists aged 8-12. "
